metadata.description: Solana PoC confidential token using the Zama host program

docs: Anchor entrypoint module for the confidential token PoC.

instructions.name: confidential_burn

Exactly one burn may be pending for a token account; redeem or cancel it before burning again.

instructions.name: confidential_burn_from_value
docs: Burns an encrypted amount taken from an existing on-chain `EncryptedValue` (a computed or
received handle) instead of a freshly attested client-side encryption — the burn-side analog
of `confidential_transfer_from_value` (fhevm-internal#1755). The batcher uses this to burn an
execution's computed encrypted total, then requests the KMS burn certificate. The signing
owner must control the amount value (the token spend gate); the amount is spent read-only,
and the burned-amount output is created publicly decryptable exactly as in
`confidential_burn`, so `redeem_burned_amount` consumes it unchanged.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Token owner and burn authority. Must control `amount_value` (the spend gate).
Not `mut`: rent for the burned-amount encrypted value account's first bind is paid by `payer`, so the owner
may be a program PDA (the batcher) that only authorizes the burn via `invoke_signed`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the burned-amount encrypted value account on its first bind.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Confidential mint whose encrypted total supply is decreased.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: Token account whose balance is decreased.

accounts.name: balance_value
docs: Stable balance encrypted value account; read for the current handle and replaced by this execution.

accounts.name: total_supply_value
docs: Stable total-supply encrypted value account; read for the current handle and replaced by this execution.

accounts.name: burned_amount_value
docs: decryptable exactly as in [`ConfidentialBurn`].

accounts.name: pending_burn
docs: A burn is rejected before execution while this account is already initialized.

accounts.name: amount_value
docs: The existing encrypted amount to burn: a computed `euint64` handle. Read-only persistent
operand — never replaced, never consumed. Its address is the canonical PDA of its own
`(program, authority, scope, label)` fields, so an encrypted value account from any app may
be passed here when that app's value authority is the signing `owner` (a program PDA
authorizing through `invoke_signed`), or when it is one of the burner's own token values.

recipient program passes `receipt` (plus `receipt_value` and its signing
`receipt_authority`) to have the transferred amount accumulated into a value of its own.

instructions.name: make_token_account_handle_public
docs: Seals one token-account state handle publicly. The owner authorizes the request and the
token-account PDA signs as encrypted value account authority.

instructions.name: make_total_supply_handle_public
docs: Seals encrypted total supply publicly. The mint authority authorizes the request and the
total-supply PDA signs as encrypted value account authority.

accounts.name: total_supply_value
docs: Encrypted total-supply value whose current handle is sealed.

instructions.name: redeem_burned_amount
docs: Redeems a KMS-certified burned amount from the SPL vault through the stateless host verifier.
Verifies the KMS `PublicDecryptVerification` certificate against the context the cert names
(any live, non-destroyed context, EVM-parity rotation grace) plus an exact-handle MMR
public-decrypt proof, then pays out `cleartext_amount` and closes the `PendingBurn`
account opened at burn time. See `instructions::redeem_burned_amount`.

docs: Token owner, redemption recipient, and rent destination for the closed pending burn.

docs: Confidential mint whose vault backs the redeemed burned amount.

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: Underlying SPL mint.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: Program vault USDC token account.

accounts.name: destination_usdc
docs: Signer's destination USDC token account (any SPL account of the right mint). Ownership is
not required: the token-account owner must still sign, which is what prevents theft.

accounts.name: burned_amount_value
docs: Burned amount `EncryptedValue` account whose handle is redeemed. Bound to the mint/token
account by `assert_burned_amount_value_account`; its canonical PDA, layout, host ownership,
and the exact-handle MMR inclusion proof are validated by the `verify_public_decrypt` CPI.

accounts.name: pending_burn
docs: Pending-burn account opened at burn time; closed on successful redemption.

accounts.name: host_config

consumes ZamaHost protocol events instead.

types.name: BurnRedeemedEvent
docs: Emitted when a KMS-certified burned amount is redeemed from the vault.
After the `BurnRedemptionRequest` witness lifecycle was dissolved (fhevm-internal#1763), redeem is
a single instruction with no request witness, so this event no longer carries a `request` PDA or
`request_hash`.

fields.name: destination_usdc
docs: Underlying token destination account.

fields.name: cleartext_amount

`EncryptedValue` account at `balance_encrypted_value`, not here — addressing

docs: Canonical state for one encrypted value.
PDA: `[ENCRYPTED_VALUE_SEED, program, encrypted_value_account_authority, scope, label]`.
The account name must stay exactly `EncryptedValue` — Anchor derives the discriminator from
the type name, and it must match `zama_solana_acl::encrypted_value_discriminator()`.

fields.name: program
docs: The application program this value belongs to. Proven on create: the authority must be a
PDA of this program (the create carries the seeds), so no other program can sign for it.

fields.name: encrypted_value_account_authority
docs: The account that controls this encrypted value: a PDA of `program` that must sign to create
it, read it into a computation, or update its handle. Enforced by address rather than by
comparing this field — the signer must equal the authority declared in the execution and
the account written must be the PDA rederived from the declared four seeds, which is what
ties the signer to the stored value. For a token balance this is the token account itself.

fields.name: scope
docs: Program-declared scope within `program` (the mint for the token program).
`(program, scope)` is the application identity for HCU metering and the deny list.

fields.name: label
docs: Which of the authority's values this is.

fields.name: current_handle
docs: Current encrypted value identifier (the live handle).

fields.name: leaf_count
docs: Number of MMR leaves appended; `0` means no history.

fields.name: peaks
docs: MMR peaks, oldest mountain first (`popcount(leaf_count)` entries).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: HandleDisclosedEvent
docs: Emitted when `disclose_secp` publishes a KMS-certified cleartext for a token-scoped handle.
This is the single app-level disclosure event after the `DisclosureRequest` lifecycle was
dissolved (fhevm-internal#1704): it covers both former balance and amount disclosures. It carries
no request witness or `request_hash` — there is no per-request PDA anymore. The request side is
the owner or mint authority sealing a public-decrypt leaf through the token wrapper that signs
the Host `make_handle_public` CPI as the field's encrypted value account authority.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: mint
docs: Confidential mint whose application scopes the disclosed encrypted value account.

fields.name: handle
docs: Disclosed handle, proven public by the host verifier.

fields.name: encrypted_value
docs: ZamaHost `EncryptedValue` encrypted value account the handle belongs to.

fields.name: kind
docs: Token state field whose canonical authority and label were validated.

fields.name: encrypted_value_account_authority
docs: Encrypted value account authority bound to `kind`.

fields.name: encrypted_value_label
docs: Encrypted value label bound to `kind`.

fields.name: cleartext_amount
docs: KMS-certified cleartext amount (low 64 bits of the certified `uint256`).

types.name: HostConfig
docs: Singleton host configuration and authority surface.
`HostConfig` is the runtime switchboard for this PoC. Production-shaped
instructions reject while paused.

fields.name: admin
docs: Program administrator allowed to update config flags.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: Host-chain id included in handle derivation.

fields.name: gateway_chain_id
docs: EVM gateway chain id used in the coprocessor/KMS EIP-712 domain separators.

fields.name: input_verification_contract
docs: EVM `InputVerification` contract address: the EIP-712 verifying contract for
coprocessor `CiphertextVerification` input attestations.

fields.name: coprocessor_signers
docs: Registered coprocessor EVM signer set for input attestations (EVM `InputVerifier`
parity). Fixed-capacity so `HostConfig` keeps a pinned byte layout; only the first
`coprocessor_signer_count` entries are active, the rest are zero padding.

fields.name: coprocessor_signer_count
docs: Number of active entries in `coprocessor_signers`.

fields.name: coprocessor_threshold
docs: Minimum distinct valid signatures (n-of-m) required over an input attestation;
`1 <= coprocessor_threshold <= coprocessor_signer_count`.

fields.name: decryption_contract
docs: EVM `Decryption` contract address: the EIP-712 verifying contract for KMS
`PublicDecryptVerification` certificates (disclose/redeem).

fields.name: current_kms_context_id
docs: Active KMS context id (mirrors `ProtocolConfig.getCurrentKmsContextId`). The
signer set + thresholds live in the `KmsContext` PDA at this id; `[0; 32]` means
none defined yet. Updated by `define_kms_context`.

fields.name: paused
docs: Pauses production-shaped host instructions when true.

fields.name: grant_deny_list_enabled
docs: Enables the deny list: a denied application `(program, scope)` cannot compute, allow, or make a handle public.

fields.name: max_hcu_per_tx
docs: Max total HCU summed over one `fhe_execute` execution. `u64::MAX` = unlimited
(enforcement off); `0` is rejected at set time.

fields.name: max_hcu_depth_per_tx
docs: Max critical-path (depth) HCU within one `fhe_execute` execution. `u64::MAX` =
unlimited; `0` is rejected at set time.

fields.name: hcu_block_cap_per_app
docs: Per-app HCU budget per slot, enforced in `fhe_execute`. `u64::MAX` = unrestricted (the ship
default; short-circuits, touching no meter); `0` = ban untrusted apps (trusted still
bypass) — the one knob where `0` is a real semantic; any other value is the metering band
(must be `>= max_hcu_per_tx` unless that is unlimited).

fields.name: updated_slot
docs: Slot in which the config was initialized or last changed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `PDA("host-config")`.

types.name: KmsContext
docs: A KMS context: the signer set + thresholds active under a `context_id`.

fields.name: context_id
docs: Opaque 32-byte context id (mirrors EVM `kmsContextId`). All-zero is reserved (none defined).

fields.name: signers
docs: KMS node signer EVM addresses authorized to sign certs in this context.

fields.name: thresholds
docs: Per-operation signature thresholds.

fields.name: destroyed
docs: True once destroyed (mirrors `destroyKmsContext`); destroyed contexts reject.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `PDA("kms-context", context_id)`.

types.name: KmsThresholds
docs: Per-operation signature thresholds for a KMS context (mirrors `KmsThresholds`).

fields.name: public_decryption
docs: Threshold for public-decrypt (disclose/redeem) certificates.

fields.name: user_decryption
docs: Threshold for user-decrypt certificates.

fields.name: kms_gen
docs: Threshold for key generation (KMS-internal; stored for fidelity).

fields.name: mpc
docs: Threshold for MPC (KMS-internal; stored for fidelity).

types.name: MmrInclusionProof
docs: Anchor-native mirror of `zama_solana_acl::MmrProof` for use as an instruction argument. The
shared ACL crate is deliberately Anchor-free (pure `borsh`) so it cannot derive Anchor IDL
metadata; this local type carries the identical wire shape and converts into the shared proof.
Defined in the host program so CPI callers depend only on the host IDL, never on token types.

fields.name: leaf_index
docs: Index of the proven leaf within the encrypted value account's MMR.

fields.name: siblings
docs: Authentication path from the leaf up to its mountain peak.

types.name: PendingBurn
docs: Open burn awaiting redeem (underlying tokens) or cancel (confidential tokens).

fields.name: mint
docs: Confidential mint whose underlying-token vault funds a redemption payout.

fields.name: owner
docs: Token account owner (rent destination on close).

fields.name: token_account
docs: Token account that produced the burned amount.

fields.name: burned_handle
docs: Burned amount handle produced by the burn execution (stored for redeem matching).

fields.name: burned_encrypted_value
docs: Shared `burned_amount` EncryptedValue account for this token account.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `(mint, token_account)`.

types.name: PendingBurnCancelledEvent
docs: Emitted when `cancel_pending_burn` re-credits a pending burn into confidential balance.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: mint
docs: Confidential mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: Token account owner (rent destination of the closed pending-burn account).

fields.name: token_account
docs: Confidential token account that produced the burned amount.

fields.name: burned_handle
docs: Burned amount handle that was cancelled (must be the current handle).

fields.name: burned_encrypted_value
docs: Shared `burned_amount` EncryptedValue account for the token account.

types.name: TotalSupplyHandleUpdatedEvent
docs: App-local total-supply history event.
This mirrors ERC7984's encrypted `_totalSupply` pointer at the Solana mint
level. The generic coprocessor listener consumes ZamaHost protocol events;
this event is for token-aware indexers.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: mint
docs: Confidential mint.

fields.name: old_handle
docs: Previous total-supply handle.

fields.name: old_encrypted_value
docs: Previous ZamaHost ACL record.

fields.name: new_handle
docs: New total-supply handle.

fields.name: new_encrypted_value
docs: New ZamaHost ACL record.

fields.name: reason
docs: Reason this total-supply pointer changed.

types.name: TotalSupplyUpdateReason
docs: Reason code for [`TotalSupplyHandleUpdatedEvent`].

types.name: TransferReceipt
docs: How a program receiving a transfer learns the amount it received: the transfer's execution
also writes `receipt = receipt + transferred` (first time `transferred + 0`) into a value of
that program, controlled by the PDA it signs the CPI with. A value's authority is the only
key that may compute on it, so the recipient cannot read `transferred_amount` itself; the
token program writes the sum into the recipient's own value instead, in the same execution
that computes it. EVM analog: `FHE.allow(transferred, recipient)` followed by the recipient's
own `add`.

fields.name: program
docs: The recipient program.

fields.name: scope
docs: The recipient program's scope for the value.

fields.name: label
docs: The value's label under `(program, receipt_authority, scope)`.

fields.name: authority_seeds
docs: Seeds (bump last) deriving `receipt_authority` under `program`; proven by the host on
the first write.

fields.name: allows
docs: Keys allowed to decrypt the receipt's new handle.
